title: 1.3.4 The Greatest Integer (Floor) Function
description: Floor function values, graphs and equations

questions.question: The greatest integer (floor) function $[x]$ is defined as:
options: the greatest integer that is less than or equal to $x$
the smallest integer that is greater than or equal to $x$
the integer obtained by rounding $x$ to the nearest integer
the integer obtained by discarding the fractional part of $x$
questions.correctAnswer: the greatest integer that is less than or equal to $x$

questions.question: The greatest integer function $[x]$ is also called:
options: the floor function or step function
questions.correctAnswer: the floor function or step function

questions.question: For the function $f(x) = [4x]$, the domain of $f$ is:
The graph of the function $f(x) = [x]$ looks like:
options: a staircase of horizontal step segments
a straight line through the origin

questions.correctAnswer: a staircase of horizontal step segments

questions.question: The function $f(x) = [x]$ increases to the next higher integer:
options: any time the x-value becomes an integer
only when $x$ is a negative number
questions.correctAnswer: any time the x-value becomes an integer
